title: Giants driven out by Joshua settle on Sardinia

tellings.quote: I think that Joshua drove out a lot of the giants that weren't killed in the conquest.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on the show of a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story drawn from the Old Testament. He says that Joshua, the leader who in the Bible leads the conquest of the land of Canaan, drove out many of the giants there who were not killed in the fighting, and that these giants went on to settle on the island of Sardinia. If true, it would mean the Bible's giants survived and left a trace far from the Holy Land.
